relation_claim0.instructions: How does the evidence relate to claim `claim0` (The build passes on main.)?

criteria.supports: The evidence states the claim or directly implies that it is true
criteria.contradicts: The evidence states the opposite of the claim or implies that it is false
criteria.says_nothing: The evidence does not address what the claim asserts, either way

source_claim0.instructions: Which evidence item does claim `claim0` (The build passes on main.) rest on?

criteria.none: No single evidence item contains the content the claim depends on
